verdict.rationale: Convex docs describe auth via third-party providers (Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit, Auth0) or its own Convex Auth library for social/email/password sign-in, but there is no evidence of built-in enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) or MFA enforcement controls for a platform engineer to configure directly; these would depend entirely on the chosen third-party provider's capabilities, which aren't documented here.
